disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.paragraph1: Mystic by Vedunya Maria is created for reflection, spiritual practice, and personal guidance.
disclaimer.paragraph2: The app does not provide medical, legal, financial, psychological, or emergency advice. If you need professional help, contact a qualified professional or local emergency services.
disclaimer.paragraph3: Daily guidance, moon rhythm, numerology, runes, reminders, and personal requests are intended as supportive reflection tools. They should not replace your judgment, responsibility, or professional support.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This prototype policy describes how Mystic on the web handles information today. It should be reviewed before public launch.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: When you use Mystic, we may store your account email, display name, date of birth, language preference, daily guidance-related profile data, optional Universe request text, course progress, and notification preferences if you enable reminders.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: We use this information to sign you in, personalize your daily practice, save your preferences, and show content in your chosen language. We do not sell your personal data.

firebase.title: Firebase and authentication
firebase.body: We use Firebase services for authentication, profile storage, and app data. Your session is managed through standard secure sign-in flows.

profile.title: Profile and date of birth
profile.body: Your name, date of birth, and language help personalize numerology and daily guidance. You can update these details in Profile.

request.title: Request the Universe
request.body: If you create a personal request, its text and optional category are stored in your account so you can return to it on Today.

notifications.title: Reminders and notifications
notifications.body: If you enable reminders, we store your reminder preferences and a push subscription for this device. We do not expose subscription details in the app interface.

courses.title: Courses and progress
courses.body: If you open courses, we may store lesson progress linked to your account so you can continue where you left off.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Payments are not active in the current web prototype. When payments are added, this policy should be reviewed and updated.

cookies.title: Cookies, local storage, and session
cookies.body: The web app may use cookies or browser storage for sign-in session, language, timezone, and installed app behavior. This supports normal app function, not advertising profiles.

deletion.title: Data deletion
deletion.body: You can request account or data deletion by contacting support from the email connected to your account. Automated self-service deletion is not available in this prototype yet.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions, contact vedunyamaria@gmail.com from the email linked to your Mystic account.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Plain-language prototype terms for Mystic on the web. Review with legal counsel before public launch.

use.title: Use of the app
use.body: Mystic is offered for personal reflection and spiritual practice. You agree to use it respectfully and lawfully.

reflection.title: Reflection and spiritual practice only
reflection.body: Guidance, moon rhythm, numerology, runes, and reminders are supportive tools — not professional advice or guaranteed outcomes.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: You are responsible for your account access and for keeping your sign-in details secure. Provide accurate profile information where requested.

payments.title: Subscriptions and payments
payments.body: Mystic Plus and course payments are not active in the current web prototype. When billing is added, these terms should be updated.

content.title: Courses and content
content.body: Course materials, rune content, and guidance text belong to Vedunya Maria and licensors. You may use them for personal practice, not for unauthorized redistribution.

misuse.title: No harmful misuse
misuse.body: Do not misuse the app to harass others, attempt unauthorized access, or interfere with normal operation.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: We aim for a calm, reliable experience, but features may change, pause, or be unavailable during prototype testing.

responsibility.title: Limitation of responsibility
responsibility.body: Mystic is provided as-is for reflection support. You remain responsible for your decisions and for seeking professional help when needed.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: These prototype terms may change as Mystic on the web evolves. Material updates should be communicated before public launch.
